Easy Marshmallow Icing
By: Michelle Tancioco
Published: Friday, June 10, 2011 - 3:26am

Ingredients




Cupcakes
Marshmallows (plain or flavored)

Preparation

1 Bake your cupcakes 2 After baking, take a marshmallow and place it on top of each cupcakes 3 Place your cupcakes back into the oven. (Oh well, I don't have an oven so I used turbo broiler for baking.) 4 After a minute, use the back of the spoon to mash down the marshmallows to help them spread evenly 5 Then place it back to the oven or turbo broiler for another 2 minutes. 6 THE END!!!

About


Too lazy to frost my cupcakes... Got this from this link - http://www.chicaandjo.com/2009/07/21/easy-marshmallow-icing-recipes/
